    {"name": "root_cause_mechanism_or_failure_pattern", "analytical_usefulness": 0.75, "source_groundedness": 0.5, "rationale": "Failure-pattern grouping is analytically useful.     {"name": "is_recurring_or_duplicate_issue", "analytical_usefulness": 0.55, "source_groundedness": 0.3, "rationale": "Recurrence could plausibly relate to resolution time, but the column is near-constant (421 true / 79 false) reducing leverage, and the flag is largely unsupported: 'Unable to access the database' or 'Software update issue' give no evidence of recurrence, yet they are marked true.", "hallucination_observed": true},
    {"name": "single_agent_ownership_or_no_reassignment", "analytical_usefulness": 0.7, "source_groundedness": 0.55, "rationale": "Reassignment/handoff is a genuinely plausible signal for longer resolution, giving real analytical leverage. Groundedness is uncertain since the table has no reassignment history field shown; the value appears inferred rather than clearly warranted.", "hallucination_observed": false},
    {"name": "extended_time_to_final_closure_or_last_update_lag", "analytical_usefulness": 0.65, "source_groundedness": 0.4, "rationale": "A lag flag is directly relevant to resolution duration. But in the samples closed_at equals sys_updated_on exactly, so there is no observable lag, yet some rows are marked true; the flag appears not derivable from the available timestamps and risks circularity with the target.", "hallucination_observed": true},
    {"name": "infrastructure_dependency", "analytical_usefulness": 0.45, "source_groundedness": 0.85, "rationale": "This is almost a one-to-one restatement of issue_type_or_category (email->email_infrastructure, vpn->vpn_gateway), adding little new analytical axis. Values are well grounded in the descriptions.", "hallucination_observed": false}
  ],
  "analytical_usefulness": 0.65,
  "source_groundedness": 0.55,
  "rationale": "The column set provides several genuine grouping axes (issue type, scope, root cause, ownership/reassignment, closure lag) relevant to why an agent's tickets take longer, so table-level usefulness is moderately high. However, some columns dilute this: infrastructure_dependency largely restates issue_type, and assigned_agent duplicates existing original columns. Groundedness is mixed: type and infrastructure labels read soundly from short_description, but scope/impact, root-cause mechanism, recurrence, and the closure-lag flag frequently assert specifics the terse descriptions and equal-timestamp evidence do not support, indicating several confident inventions."
}
